test_role_and_ordering.why_test_a_precedes_test_b: Built-in TmFinishIteration (forge/r15dsg/src/search.cpp:175, 2962, 3188-3219) requires zero C++ build and matches Stockfish's policy of refusing to start a new depth late in soft time rather than cutting mid-iteration. Stockfish (def601cc, src/search.cpp:2155) avoids mid-iteration soft aborts below tm.maximum() because a mid-iteration cut (such as TmSoftCapPercent=200) carries a mid-iteration fail-low abort risk where a resolving fail-low is cut short before completing. Therefore Opus ordered Test A (TmFinishIteration=true vs false) strictly before Test B (TmSoftCapPercent=200).
